claims: Dan Levy's new show is titled "Big Mistakes".
"Big Mistakes" is a Netflix comedy thriller.
"Big Mistakes" is set to premiere on April 9, 2026.
Dan Levy and Taylor Ortega play two siblings in "Big Mistakes".
The siblings try to manage a family crisis involving their grandmother in "Big Mistakes".
The siblings accidentally become involved with organized crime in "Big Mistakes".
Laurie Metcalf plays their mother in "Big Mistakes".
"Big Mistakes" is co-created by Dan Levy and Rachel Sennott (Bottoms).
"Big Mistakes" is the first series from Dan Levy's creative partnership with Netflix.
Dan Levy's 2023 directorial debut is "Good Grief".
